yellow.$description: Classic sticky-note paper. Runtime reference so theme ramp overrides apply.

orange.$description: Runtime reference so theme ramp overrides apply.

blue.$description: Runtime reference so theme ramp overrides apply.

pink.$description: Runtime reference so theme ramp overrides apply.

purple.$description: Runtime reference so theme ramp overrides apply.

grey.$description: Runtime reference so theme ramp overrides apply.

foreground.$description: Text on every note colour — paper stays light in dark mode, so this does not flip.

mutedForeground.$description: Secondary text on a note; one step darker than the page's muted text to keep AA on tinted paper.

raisedSurface.$description: Surface for raised elements on a note, such as the author badge.

stripHeight.$description: The slightly darker adhesive strip along the top edge.

floatingOffset.$description: Inset from the positioned parent's corner for placement="floating".

zIndex.$description: Content layer: a floating note sits above in-flow content but below sticky chrome (semantic.z.sticky) and popovers.

shadow.$description: Note elevation: one step above cards so notes read as lifted off the page. Follows theme shadow overrides.
